title: Furniture & Upholstery Cleaning
text:

Furniture & Upholstery Cleaning in Orange County, CA Furniture & upholstery cleaning by Carpet and Duct Cleaning restores sofas, chairs, sectionals, and loveseats throughout Orange County, CA. Our certified technicians remove deep-set dirt, allergens, pet dander, and stubborn stains using safe, fabric-specific methods — with no harsh chemicals that damage fibers or fade colors. Every piece of furniture receives the care it deserves, leaving your home cleaner and healthier. Why Choose Carpet and Duct Cleaning? Our trained technicians inspect and test each fabric type before applying any solution. We handle cotton, linen, polyester, velvet, microfiber, leather, wool, and synthetic blends. Every service includes pre-treatment of problem spots, hot water extraction or dry cleaning (based on fabric type), and a final fabric protector application that extends upholstery life by years. We are IICRC certified and BBB A+ rated, serving Orange County since 2013. Types of Furniture We Clean We provide furniture & upholstery cleaning for all furniture types — sofas, sectionals, armchairs, dining chairs, ottomans, and loveseats — for homes, offices, restaurants, and hotels throughout Orange County. Both light surface cleaning and deep stain removal are available based on your needs. Our furniture & upholstery cleaning process eliminates bacteria, dust mites, and allergens that build up in fabric fibers over time. How Often Should You Clean Your Furniture? Most homes benefit from professional furniture & upholstery cleaning every 12-18 months. Households with pets, children, or allergy sufferers may need service every 6-12 months. Regular professional cleaning extends the lifespan of your furniture, maintains fabric integrity, and keeps your indoor environment healthier for your family. Dirty upholstery can harbor bacteria and allergens that affect indoor air quality. Our Furniture & Upholstery Cleaning Process We begin with a thorough inspection of your furniture's fabric type and condition. Our technicians then apply a pre-treatment solution to loosen embedded dirt, stains, and odors. Using hot water extraction or dry cleaning methods (depending on fabric requirements), we deep clean every surface. A final conditioning treatment protects fibers from future staining. The entire furniture & upholstery cleaning process is safe for children and pets, using eco-friendly, non-toxic solutions. Fabric Types We Service Our furniture & upholstery cleaning team is trained to handle all fabric types including microfiber, velvet, cotton, linen, polyester, leather, suede, and specialty blends. We pre-test all cleaning solutions on a hidden area before applying to the full piece. This ensures color safety and prevents any damage to delicate materials. Service Area We provide furniture & upholstery cleaning services throughout Orange County, CA, including Irvine, Anaheim, Costa Mesa, Newport Beach, Laguna Beach, and surrounding communities. Contact us today at (949) 992-3299 to schedule your professional furniture and upholstery cleaning appointment.
